regulatory_framework: Government of Maharashtra School Education Department GR & National Education Policy (NEP 2020)
rules_summary: For admission into Pre-Primary and Grade 1 for the 2026-2027 academic session, the child must complete the stipulated age on or before 31st December 2026.

grade_age_mapping.minimum_age: Sequential progression based on passing previous standard from a recognized school
grade_age_mapping.requirement: Must have successfully passed previous standard and have valid School Leaving Certificate / Transfer Certificate (LC/TC).

underage_policy: No relaxations in the minimum age criteria are permissible as per state education department regulations.
